method: Playwright walkthroughs (admin + recruiter, 40+ pages), 3 code-analysis audits (coverage, redundancy, RBAC), live end-to-end verification against freshly reseeded test DB.

bugs.title: Requested by-source / by-client / by-vendor breakdowns and open-job aging report are absent
bugs.detail: PROJECT_REQUIREMENTS §9.11 asks for 'Jobs by source/client/vendor', 'Company/vendor/client-wise performance' and an 'Open job aging report'. These were removed as de-clutter. The Analytics tab still shows Source/Client/Vendor filters (they still constrain the remaining conversion + recruiter figures), but there is no dimension breakdown behind them, so a manager who asks 'show performance by client/vendor' finds nothing.
bugs.recommendation: Restore a lightweight jobs-by-client/vendor/source table + open-job-aging, or drop the now-thin filters so the tab matches what it delivers.

bugs.title: Scorecard metrics rest on shaky/unconfirmed definitions (Backouts, New vendors, Closures)
bugs.detail: Backouts are bucketed on the submission's submittedAt week, not the week the back-out happened, so they can land in the wrong week. 'New vendors' (company-wide first-ever) reads 0 for any re-touched vendor, and 'Closures' uses placement startDate as a proxy - both are gated on still-open owner questions. This is the single most likely surface to show a number a client disputes on stage.
bugs.recommendation: Before demo: fix Backouts to bucket on the back-out event date and confirm New-vendors/Closures semantics with the owner, OR hide/caveat the Monthly Performance tab for this demo.

bugs.title: Résumé & document upload depends on BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN, which is missing from .env.example
bugs.detail: Uploads and the private serve routes require BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN. It IS set in this machine's .env (verified: résumé + document routes return 200 application/pdf gzip), so the demo works HERE. But the token is absent from .env.example, so a fresh clone, a teammate's machine, or a Vercel preview will silently fail every upload with no obvious error.
bugs.evidence: .env has token; .env.example does not; src/server/blob-upload.ts, api/resumes/[id], api/documents/[id]
bugs.screen: candidate detail (résumé upload), submission new (inline upload)
bugs.recommendation: Add BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN (documented placeholder) to .env.example and confirm it is set wherever the demo actually runs.

bugs.title: Job's Client rate is not carried into the VPR form - team lead re-types it
bugs.detail: The Job captures Client rate (and optionally vendor/candidate rate). The VPR 'new' page loads the job but forwards only 'location' as a default; clientRate is never pre-filled, so it is re-keyed by hand. This is both a friction point and a transcription-error risk (the client rate could be entered differently at the VPR than the job).
bugs.recommendation: Select job.clientRate and pass it as defaults.clientRate (editable), matching the existing location carry-forward.

bugs.title: 'Interviews' means different things on different screens (81 rounds vs 49 interviewed submissions)
bugs.detail: Dashboard KPI 'Interviews = 81' counts interview ROUNDS; Reports says '49 of 160 submissions reached an interview' (distinct submissions); Monthly Performance counts rounds scheduled in the month. All three are internally correct but share the label 'Interviews', inviting a 'why don't these match?' question in a live demo.
bugs.evidence: dashboard.ts (rounds) vs reports.ts (distinct submissions) vs monthly-scorecard.ts (rounds/month)
bugs.recommendation: Relabel to disambiguate: 'Interview rounds' vs 'Candidates interviewed'.

bugs.title: Jobs list lacks per-row #interviews / #selected / #joined columns
bugs.detail: Spec §9.2 asks each job row to show number of interviews, number selected, number joined. Only #submissions is present.
bugs.recommendation: Add the three count columns (hidden-by-default via the existing ColumnsMenu is fine).

bugs.title: Interviews list missing Vendor, Location, and Remarks columns
bugs.detail: The June-19 'Interviews' tab lists Vendor, Location, and Remarks; the /interviews roll-up omits them.
bugs.recommendation: Add Vendor + Location + Remarks (Remarks can map to round feedback/notes).

bugs.title: Dashboard missing 'Jobs by sister-company source' and 'Aging jobs'
bugs.detail: Spec §9.1 lists both; neither is rendered (source filter exists but no metric; aging logic not surfaced).
bugs.recommendation: Add a small Jobs-by-source bar and an aging-jobs count, or note as intentionally deferred.

bugs.title: Recruiter can open 'Add job' and view the Settings page (read-only)
bugs.detail: createJob is not admin-gated, so a recruiter can create a job; the Settings page renders read-only lists for recruiters (write controls are correctly isAdmin-gated, so nothing breaks on click, and Export/Audit are Forbidden). This matches the original MVP ('everyone can add/edit') but sits oddly with the new three-tier framing where jobs originate with the team lead. Not a security leak - a product decision to confirm.
bugs.evidence: src/server/actions/jobs.ts (no role guard on create); settings/page.tsx:39 isAdmin gating; recruiter probe: /settings/export + /audit => 'Forbidden'
bugs.recommendation: Confirm intended policy with the client; if jobs are team-lead-only, gate createJob and hide the Settings nav for recruiters.

bugs.title: Google Drive résumé/document link entry removed in favor of upload-only
bugs.detail: Spec §11 says 'allow resume upload locally' AND 'also allow users to paste a Google Drive link'. The app is now upload-only (private Vercel Blob, PDF/DOCX). This was a deliberate owner decision, but it is a spec deviation - make it a conscious talking point rather than a demo surprise.
bugs.evidence: resume-form.tsx (file upload only); Drive fields dropped in migration 20260706180000/200000
bugs.recommendation: Confirm with owner; if Drive links are still wanted, re-add an optional link field alongside upload.

bugs.title: Direct 'New submission' entry points don't prefill from an existing OPEN VPR
bugs.detail: The VPR convert path prefills the full commercial block (good). The three direct 'new submission' entries start blank even when the job has an OPEN VPR, so effort depends on which door the user picks.
bugs.recommendation: When a job has an OPEN VPR, offer to prefill from it.

bugs.title: Job status not enforced as required (defaults to OPEN)
bugs.detail: Spec §9.3 lists Status among required fields; the form defaults to OPEN without enforcement.
bugs.recommendation: Cosmetic; leave defaulted or mark required per spec.

bugs.title: No celebratory 'pop' on Joined / Backed-out
bugs.detail: The June-19 Placements tab hints 'Give Pop Like Joined Or Back out'. The app shows a confirm dialog + success toast + JOINED->placement cascade, but no distinct celebratory moment.
bugs.recommendation: Optional: a brief success animation on Joined.

bugs.title: Interview 'Time' merged into the Date column
bugs.detail: The Excel tab lists Date and Time separately; the roll-up shows a combined datetime.
bugs.recommendation: Cosmetic; split if the client wants a distinct Time column.

bugs.title: CLAUDE.md says Job is trimmed to client-rate-only, but vendor/candidate rate inputs still exist
bugs.detail: The Job form still has vendor/candidate rate inputs, moved into a collapsible 'More details' section labelled as usually-set-on-the-requirement. The doc note overstates the trim.
bugs.recommendation: Update the note to 'demoted into More details', not 'removed'.

bugs.title: Bench marketing password over-fetched in getBenchConsultant
bugs.detail: getBenchConsultant uses include with no field-level select, pulling marketingPassword for every viewer. The Server Component discards it before render for non-admins (so it never reaches the client HTML - not a live leak), but it is a latent footgun if the row is ever forwarded to a Client Component.
bugs.recommendation: Use a conditional select so the password is only fetched for admins.
